entries.title: Ephesians 1:1
segments: ¶Paul, apostle of Jesus Christ by God's will, to the saints and faithful in Christ Jesus who are at Ephesus.

entries.title: Ephesians 1:2
segments: Grace to you and peace from God our Father, and [the] Lord Jesus Christ.

entries.title: Ephesians 1:3
segments: ¶Blessed [be] the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us with every spiritual blessing in the heavenlies in Christ;

entries.title: Ephesians 1:4
segments: according as he has chosen us in him before [the] world's foundation, that we should be holy and blameless before him in love;

entries.title: Ephesians 1:5
segments: having marked us out beforehand for adoption through Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his will,

entries.title: Ephesians 1:6
segments: to [the] praise of [the] glory of his grace, wherein he has taken us into favour in the Beloved:

entries.title: Ephesians 1:7
segments: in whom we have redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of offences, according to the riches of his grace;

entries.title: Ephesians 1:8
segments: which he has caused to abound towards us in all wisdom and intelligence,

entries.title: Ephesians 1:9
segments: having made known to us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he purposed in himself

entries.title: Ephesians 1:10
segments: for [the] administration of the fulness of times; to head up all things in the Christ, the things in the heavens and the things upon the earth; in him,

entries.title: Ephesians 1:11
segments: in whom we have also obtained an inheritance, being marked out beforehand according to the purpose of him who works all things according to the counsel of his own will,

entries.title: Ephesians 1:12
segments: that we should be to [the] praise of his glory who have pre-trusted in the Christ:

entries.title: Ephesians 1:13
segments: in whom *ye* also [have trusted], having heard the word of the truth, the glad tidings of your salvation; in whom also, having believed, ye have been sealed with the Holy Spirit of promise,

entries.title: Ephesians 1:14
segments: who is [the] earnest of our inheritance to the redemption of the acquired possession to [the] praise of his glory.

entries.title: Ephesians 1:15
segments: ¶Wherefore *I* also, having heard of the faith in the Lord Jesus which [is] in you, and the love which [ye have] towards all the saints,

entries.title: Ephesians 1:16
segments: do not cease giving thanks for you, making mention [of you] at my prayers,

entries.title: Ephesians 1:17
segments: that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, would give you [the] spirit of wisdom and revelation in the full knowledge of him,

entries.title: Ephesians 1:18
segments: being enlightened in the eyes of your heart, so that ye should know what is the hope of his calling, [and] what the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints,

entries.title: Ephesians 1:19
segments: and what the surpassing greatness of his power towards us who believe, according to the working of the might of his strength,

entries.title: Ephesians 1:20
segments: [in] which he wrought in the Christ [in] raising him from among [the] dead, and he set him down at his right hand in the heavenlies,

entries.title: Ephesians 1:21
segments: above every principality, and authority, and power, and dominion, and every name named, not only in this age, but also in that to come;

entries.title: Ephesians 1:22
segments: and has put all things under his feet, and gave him [to be] head over all things to the assembly,

entries.title: Ephesians 1:23
segments: which is his body, the fulness of him who fills all in all:
